programme.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Hannibal Lecter comes out of hiding to draw Agent Clarice Starling into a high-stakes battle.

programme.title: Audrey Rose

programme.title: Theater Of Blood

programme.title: The Black Sleep

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space

programme.title: Doctor Blood's Coffin
programme.desc: The demented Doctor Blood thinks he can create the “perfect" human from a corpse. But when he needs a live donor, his neighbors begin to vanish!

programme.title: The Bloody Judge

programme.title: The Blood On Satan's Claw

programme.title: The Vampire Lovers
programme.desc: In 18th century Europe, a vampire with lesbian tendencies ravages the young girls and townsfolk who, years earlier, killed off her fellow vampires.

programme.title: The Curse

programme.title: The Burning

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp III: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Under inept new management, Camp Rolling Hills is now Camp New Horizons and it's the ideal setting for a notorious psychopath like Angela Baker to do what she does best, eliminating "immoral" teenagers with everything from a knife to a lawnmower.

programme.title: The Monster That Challenged The World
programme.desc: The beaches go from fun-filled swim-fests to horrifying slug-fests when gargantuan vampire snails threaten to suck the life out of all mankind!

programme.title: The Manster
programme.desc: An American reporter in Japan becomes the unwitting subject of a mad scientist’s twisted experiment in this terrifying tale of ambition gone berserk.

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programme.title: Donovan's Brain
programme.desc: Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its own�and is controlling him through telepathic messages!

programme.title: Monkey Shines: An Experiment In Fear
programme.desc: In this classic spine-tingler, a paralyzed man (Jason Beghe) is cared for by Ella, an intelligent monkey. But when Ella seems to begin reading Allan's darker thoughts, he must stop the cunning maniacal creature...before she takes over his mind!

programme.title: Invaders From Mars

programme.title: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back

programme.title: The Dark Half
